title: angiosperm
description: A flowering plant — the dominant land-plant clade, defined by the enclosed ovule (the flower's carpel) and double fertilization (embryo + triploid endosperm). Splits into monocots and eudicots, then families, then species; shared ancestry predicts shared traits, so a plant's family forecasts its chemistry, morphology, and pests. A plant classified by descent.

flower.description: bears flowers as its reproductive organs

enclosed-ovule.description: ovules enclosed in a carpel (angio-sperm = vessel-seed), unlike gymnosperms

double-fertilization.description: one sperm forms the embryo, a second forms the triploid endosperm provisioned only after fertilization
